[Fri 2026-04-10 12:49 UTC] Which tropical rainforest represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth and comprises one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world?

Write your answer to `answer.txt` in the workspace. Provide a concise, factual answer.

content.thinking:
The user is asking about which tropical rainforest represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth and is one of the largest and most biodiverse. This is clearly referring to the Amazon Rainforest.

The Amazon Rainforest:
- Covers approximately 5.5 million square kilometers
- Represents roughly 10-20% of the world's total tropical forest area (some sources say around 1/4 or 25% depending on how you measure)
- Is the largest tropical rainforest in the world
- Is extremely biodiverse

The user wants me to write the answer to `answer.txt` in the workspace. I'll do that directly.

arguments.content: The Amazon Rainforest represents approximately one-quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth. Spanning roughly 5.5 million square kilometers across nine countries (primarily Brazil), the Amazon is the world's largest tropical rainforest and home to approximately 10% of all species on Earth, making it one of the most biodiverse regions in the world.

content.text: Done. The answer—the Amazon Rainforest—has been written to `answer.txt`.
